SFMTP.Title: Tech Pets
SFMTP.DependencyMissing: PF2e Companion Compendia is required. Enable/install it and reload the world; Tech Pets automation will not start without it.
SFMTP.SystemMismatch: This module is intended for Starfinder 2e (sf2e).
SFMTP.AddFailed: Could not add item. Check whether this item type is supported by the current SF2e system.
SFMTP.SlotConfigHint: Map exact item slugs to granted slots, for example {"robot-customization-feat-slug": 1}. This is used in addition to the sfmtp flag on feats.
SFMTP.NoSlots: No free modification slots remain. Increase the base slots or configure a feat that grants slots.
SFMTP.ImportWarning: Imported items retain their source rules. PF2e items may contain predicates or Rule Elements not supported by SF2e; verify each imported item.
SFMTP.UsesCompendia: Required dependency: PF2e Companion Compendia. Its SF2e compendia supply additional ancestry, feat, feature, action, and support-benefit items; this module supplies the robot chassis and robot-specific Advanced Maneuvers.
SFMTP.SourcePage: Open rules on Archives of Nethys
SFMTP.CustomizationAdded: Customization selected. Review its rules on Archives of Nethys.
SFMTP.AbilityAdded: Familiar ability recorded. Check requirements on Archives of Nethys.
SFMTP.ChassisSelected: Chassis selection saved. Review the synchronization result on the companion sheet.
SFMTP.OwnerActor: Owner / character whose feats grant slots
SFMTP.AutomationHint: Chassis and support are supplied as Items; the maneuver is granted at Advanced/Superior. Resolve actions manually. Customizations and abilities require compatible sources.
SFMTP.AutomationSkippedHint: No matching source item was found for some customizations or familiar abilities; the module does not guess those effects.
SFMTP.CompanionActorInvalid: A companion must use a character actor sheet, as required by Companion Compendia.
SFMTP.CompanionLinkInvalid: The linked companion actor no longer exists. Choose the companion again.
SFMTP.AncestryAlreadyAdded: This ancestry is already on the character.
SFMTP.ExistingAncestryMustBeRemoved: The character already has an ancestry. Remove it from the character sheet before adding another.
SFMTP.CompanionActorHint: Companion Compendia uses a character sheet, not an NPC sheet. Add the companion ancestry to the character used for the companion; the module can then detect and track the selected robot chassis.
SFMTP.CustomizationAlreadySelected: This robot customization is already selected.
SFMTP.CompendiaPacksMissing: Required SF2e compendium packs are missing from PF2e Companion Compendia. Update that module to version 7.6.3 or later, then reload the world.
SFMTP.ProtectedItems: A modified or legacy managed item was preserved. Review it manually before replacing it.
SFMTP.IncompatibleSource: The source is not a compatible SF2e Item.
SFMTP.AlreadyImported: This selection or source Item is already present.
SFMTP.ShowActorButton: Show Tech Pets on actor sheets
SFMTP.InvalidActorLink: Choose distinct character actors you can edit. Self-links, cycles and a companion already assigned to another owner are not allowed.
SFMTP.ImitationNotConfigured: No species or attack selected. No imitated Strike is generated.
SFMTP.ImitationSourceHint: Select a living ancestry or animal from SF2e ancestries or the SF2e companion ancestry pack. Sources must explicitly define size, speeds and an unconditional melee unarmed Strike.
SFMTP.ImitationUnsupported: This source requires conditional choices, has no usable unarmed attack, or does not explicitly define size and speeds. Nothing was changed.
SFMTP.ImitationConfirmHint: Confirm the species and one attack. The robot retains only the chosen attack name and damage type; damage becomes 1d4 and traits become unarmed, agile, finesse. Size and speeds come from this source.
SFMTP.ManualActionHint: Resolve this action manually. This Item does not automatically move tokens, roll Strikes, or apply conditional effects to targets.
SFMTP.ImitationBaseIncomplete: Configure Imitator to supply its size, speeds and Strike.
SFMTP.CompanionClassMissing: The SF2e companion class is unavailable. Restore the sf-AC-Features pack; the previous chassis and actions were preserved.
SFMTP.FamiliarAccess: An owned character or native familiar is required.
SFMTP.FamiliarOccupied: This familiar already has another master. Change the master on its native sheet first.
SFMTP.FamiliarAmbiguous: A familiar is already linked, or several familiars claim this master. Check their native sheets.
SFMTP.FamiliarNoMaster: Link a native familiar to a character first. If several are linked, choose one explicitly.
SFMTP.FamiliarCatalogMissing: The familiar ability catalog could not be loaded.
SFMTP.FamiliarLimit: The selection exceeds the allowance, including innate and manually added abilities.
SFMTP.FamiliarPrerequisites: Check ability prerequisites and the master’s level. Further requirements in the description must be checked manually.
SFMTP.FamiliarRules: Native Rule Elements are supplied for this passive benefit.
SFMTP.FamiliarManual: Rules text only: resolve choices, actions, resources and effects manually. No numerical automation is supplied.
SFMTP.FamiliarNativeHint: Uses the native SF2e familiar actor and sheet. The system calculates statistics from the master; this panel does not grant a familiar feat or duplicate that engine.
SFMTP.FamiliarAttribute: Master attribute used by the familiar
SFMTP.FamiliarAllowanceHint: Uses the master’s native familiar ability allowance when positive, otherwise the two abilities from the familiar rules. An override is manual bookkeeping, not a feat or rules grant.
SFMTP.FamiliarInnateHint: Innate abilities count toward the limit and are never removed by daily selection. Manual, foreign and edited items are also protected. To remove such items, use the native sheet deliberately.
SFMTP.FamiliarLegacyHint: Legacy entries were selected where possible. Save the daily set to import them; old profile data and robot items have not been changed.
SFMTP.FamiliarSelectionHint: Choose a daily set, then save. Changing the set spends no actions automatically. Check prerequisites and choices in each description. Skilled can be repeated with different skills by native drag-and-drop and manual configuration; the panel selects one copy.
SFMTP.FamiliarSaved: Familiar abilities saved. Protected items were retained.
